policy.completion_requires: Merged source, passing tests, and recorded evidence; UI-only or stub implementations do not count.
policy.task_claims: When starting a task mark in_progress; use base commit/PR review to avoid duplicated edits.

tasks.title: Prepare Android CI and compile probe
acceptance: GitHub Actions completes Android ARM64 debug APK build
APK artifact exists
Pipeline runs on PR

tasks.title: Verify upstream code licensing before public binary release
tasks.blocker: Upstream README labels MIT but no LICENSE file was found; confirm applicable licence with upstream maintainer.
acceptance: Distribution rights documented

tasks.title: Separate desktop native dependencies from Android
acceptance: Android target compiles without desktop audio libraries
Desktop audio remains functional

tasks.title: Implement safe project ZIP import into app-private storage
acceptance: Validated ZIP paths, size and entry limits
No path traversal or symlink extraction
Opening a genuine Essentials v21.1 project succeeds
Original ZIP remains unchanged

tasks.title: Implement project ZIP export with lossless file preservation
acceptance: Exported project reopens in desktop Essentials Studio
Unmodified files preserved byte-for-byte
Save failure does not overwrite original

tasks.title: Android content URI and app storage image-loading compatibility
acceptance: Tilesets, autotiles and sprites display on phone
No unscoped filesystem access

tasks.title: Verify complete XP map editing and layered tile roundtrip
acceptance: Three map layers and autotiles round-trip
Passages and priorities remain identical unless edited

tasks.title: Verify event pages, conditional commands and script roundtrip
acceptance: Events retain conditions, triggers and page order
Custom Essentials scripts remain intact

tasks.title: Verify Pokémon Essentials PBS data preservation
acceptance: Pokémon forms, moves and item files round-trip
No unrecognised fields or comments lost without explicit approval

tasks.title: Phone-friendly gestures and responsive editing controls
acceptance: Map editing works without hover/right-click
Event panels scroll correctly on phone
Back navigation never discards unsaved work

tasks.title: Android on-device smoke test and crash evidence
acceptance: Launch, edit, save, export, reopen on Android ARM64
Logs and device/OS version captured

tasks.title: Select compatible Android Essentials playtest integration
acceptance: Game launch either documented through an external runtime or clearly marked unsupported

tasks.title: Web target feasibility review, no implementation until Android gate
acceptance: WebAssembly vs server-backend tradeoff and effort captured
